# Amulet Arsenal — by AVBforge

> Free, open-source, air-gap-friendly tools for Bitcoin self-custody and encryption.
> Every tool is a single HTML file you can download, read, verify (SHA-256) and run
> fully offline in any browser — no install, no accounts, no telemetry, no third party.
> Built and tested before release; "value for value", never sold.

## Key pages

- [Home / The Arsenal](https://avbforge.com/): overview of all tools, trust signals, testing ethos.
- [About — True Bitcoin self-sovereignty](https://avbforge.com/about.html): what the tools do, how they help, real use cases, and the creator ("mr 21").
- [Verify the code](https://avbforge.com/verify.html): step-by-step guide to checking a downloaded file against its SHA-256.
- [SHA256SUMS](https://avbforge.com/SHA256SUMS.txt): SHA-256 hash of every published tool.
- [Download bundle](https://avbforge.com/amulet-arsenal.zip): the whole Arsenal in one .zip, to run locally.
- [Source code](https://codeberg.org/avbforge/pages): full source to read, fork or rebuild.

## Guides: what each tool does and how to use it

- [Offline Bitcoin wallet generator](https://avbforge.com/offline-bitcoin-wallet-generator/): create a 12 or 24 word BIP-39 seed offline, with optional dice or card entropy (Amulet Generator).
- [Encrypted Bitcoin seed vault](https://avbforge.com/encrypted-bitcoin-seed-vault/): store seed phrases in encrypted files you control, AES-GCM-256 + Argon2id (Amulet Vault).
- [Watch-only Bitcoin balance checker](https://avbforge.com/watch-only-bitcoin-balance-checker/): check balances from an xpub, ypub or zpub without a private key (Amulet Scryer).
- [Offline Bitcoin transaction signer](https://avbforge.com/offline-bitcoin-transaction-signer/): build and sign a PSBT on an air-gapped machine, no hardware wallet needed (Amulet Transaction Creator, beta).
- [Broadcast a signed Bitcoin transaction](https://avbforge.com/broadcast-bitcoin-transaction-tor/): send a signed PSBT or raw transaction over clearnet or Tor (Amulet Broadcaster).
- [Offline passphrase generator](https://avbforge.com/offline-passphrase-generator/): build a strong passphrase from a 10,000-word pool, 13.29 bits per word (Amulet Picker).

## The tools

Each tool lives at a stable short address that always serves the current version.
Exact file names and hashes for every release are in SHA256SUMS.

- [Amulet Main](https://avbforge.com/main/): single-file launcher for the whole Arsenal.
- [Amulet Generator](https://avbforge.com/generator/): offline wallet generator with verifiable entropy (dice/cards), Silent Payments, Taproot, Bech32 and legacy support.
- [Amulet Vault](https://avbforge.com/vault/): local encrypted vault for seeds and keys (AES-GCM-256 + Argon2id), with watch-only export.
- [Amulet Shamir Split](https://avbforge.com/shamir/): Vault variant that splits the key into Shamir K-of-N shares. (Beta)
- [Amulet Scryer](https://avbforge.com/scryer/): watch-only balance viewer; never sees a private key.
- [Amulet Transaction Creator](https://avbforge.com/tx/): build and sign Bitcoin PSBTs (BIP-174) offline. (Beta)
- [Amulet Broadcaster](https://avbforge.com/broadcaster/): broadcast signed transactions via clearnet or Tor behind a gated flow.
- [Amulet Timelock](https://avbforge.com/timelock/): time-locked redeem scripts (P2SH/P2WSH) with SHA-256 checksums. (Release candidate)
- [Amulet Silent](https://avbforge.com/silent/): silent-payment wallet (BIP-352); one static address, fresh output each time. (Beta)
- [Amulet Picker](https://avbforge.com/picker/): offline passphrase generator drawing from a 10,000-word pool.
- [Project Meatgrinder · Beyond: the Hand](https://avbforge.com/thehand/): make a Bitcoin seed offline with dice, cards, dominoes or coins; separate release.
- Amulet Relic: pure-Python recovery script for encrypted .enc files; ships in the source repository (amulet_relic.py).

## Principles

- Self-custody: your keys, your coins, your rules. No central entity, no trusted third party.
- Offline-first: everything works air-gapped; only broadcasting a finished, signed transaction needs the internet.
- Verifiable: read the source and check the SHA-256 of any file before you run it.
- Free and open-source: no paywall, no premium tier. Support is value-for-value.
